title: Retrospective evaluation of abdominal MRI imaging: prognostic value and therapy monitoring in patients with pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors receiving capecitabine and temozolomide (Cap/Tem) therapy
summary:
Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors are a rare tumor group. 
To date, image morphologic assessment of treatment response has been based primarily on anatomic changes, such as size change in Response Evaluation Criteria In Solid Tumors (RECIST) criteria. However, recent studies show that these parameters are limited. Pre- and post-therapy MRI data from patients with pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors will be analyzed.
conditions: Neoplasm of uncertain or unknown behaviour of endocrine glands
Other neoplasms of uncertain or unknown behaviour of lymphoid, haematopoietic and related tissue

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-> 18 years
- NET pancreas
- Abdominal MRI imaging before therapy and after Cap/Tem therapy, if applicable.
- Cap/Tem therapy
Exclusion criteria:
- < 18 years 
- Incomplete examinations due to premature termination
- Limited image quality due to artifacts
